name: Eventogy
description_en:
Eventogy is an enterprise event platform currently aimed at banking, legal and professional-services teams. It connects invitations, client records, approvals, budgets, hospitality allocation, attendance and reporting, with branded host and attendee apps. The priority is a governed client-event record, rather than selling the maximum number of public tickets.

Its commercial model is a scoped fixed annual package with unlimited events and attendees. This removes a per-registration meter in the described offer, but exact integrations, service obligations and governance configuration still need an agreement. Website demonstrations are product illustrations, not independent proof of regulatory compliance.
description_zh:
Eventogy 目前面向银行、法律及专业服务团队，将邀请、客户记录、审批、预算、招待分配、出席和报表关联，并提供品牌主办方与参与者应用。重点是可管理的客户活动记录，而不是尽量多售公开门票。

商业方式为定制固定年费，活动和参与者不限，所述方案不按报名量计费，但准确集成、服务义务及管理配置仍需协议明确。网站演示是产品说明，不是监管合规的独立证明。

core_features.explanation_en: Keep sign-off, budget and event changes in one record.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把签批、预算及活动变更保留在同一记录中。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect check-in and personalized guest information under the programme brand.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以项目品牌关联签到与个性化来宾信息。

en: Manage a client dinner from approvals and allocation through attendance reporting.
zh: 管理客户晚宴从审批、分配到出席报表。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Use the intended policy to demo approval, budget change, replacement guest, attendance and history retrieval.
steps.zh: 按真实政策演示审批、预算变化、替换来宾、出席和历史读取。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Fixed annual programme agreement with scoped bundled services.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Bespoke fixed annual quote, with unlimited events/attendees and the listed branded apps, integrations, onboarding and support. No public amount or sustained free plan established; exact contractual services and changes require agreement.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 定制固定年费，含不限活动/人数及所列品牌应用、集成、培训和支持。未确定公开金额或持续免费方案，准确服务与变更需协议明确。

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Follow an invitation through approval and attendance
sections.title_zh: 沿邀请核对审批与到场
sections.en: The homepage demonstrates a registration moving through compliance review and sign-off, then a host app updating arrival while the attendee has a personal agenda. For an illustrative client dinner, define the invitation owner, approval policy, hospitality allocation and attendance record. Test a replacement guest or budget change and inspect what remains in the record. Demonstration names, amounts and times are not observed customer transactions.
sections.zh: 首页演示报名经检查和签批，再由主办方应用更新到场、来宾查看个人议程。例如客户晚宴，应定义邀请负责人、审批政策、招待分配和出席记录，测试替换来宾或预算变更后留下什么记录。演示姓名、金额和时间不是实际观察的客户交易。

sections.title_en: Fixed annual cost still needs a defined scope
sections.title_zh: 固定年费仍需明确范围
sections.en: The pricing page offers a bespoke annual package including unlimited events and attendees, branding, both apps, integrations, onboarding/training, support and an account manager. It says no per-ticket or overage bills and no tier-based usage meter. No public amount was established. Confirm the named CRM/finance integrations, environment, administrator rights, changes and support commitments rather than translating unlimited attendees into unlimited custom development.
sections.zh: 价格页提供定制年度组合，含不限活动与人数、品牌、两类应用、集成、入职培训、支持和客户经理，说明无按票或超额收费，也无分层用量表。本次未确定公开金额。应明确 CRM/财务连接、环境、管理员权限、变更及支持，不把不限人数解释成不限定制开发。

sections.title_en: Test the controls against your actual policy
sections.en: An approval trail is useful only if the relevant action cannot silently bypass the intended permissions and reviewers can retrieve its history. Ask a scoped demo to show guest-list visibility, exports, changes, sign-off and budget exceptions under your own rules. The vendor’s security credentials and regulated-sector references were not independently audited here. No product configuration or access-control test was performed.
sections.zh: 审批轨迹只有在相关动作不能悄悄绕过预期权限、审核人能读取历史时才有用。演示应按真实规则展示名单可见性、导出、变更、签批和预算异常。本文未独立审计厂商安全资质及受监管行业案例，也未配置或测试访问控制。

sections.title_zh: 按企业客户活动计划评估
sections.en: Eventogy deserves investigation for recurring enterprise client events and hospitality where approval and records matter. A small public ticketed event may not justify an annual programme agreement. The page advertises UK-based support from 7am to 10pm, but days, timezone, SLA and holiday coverage require contract confirmation. Source license, self-hosting, data retention, offline check-in reconciliation and recovery were not verified.
sections.zh: 重复企业客户活动和招待重视审批与记录时，可研究 Eventogy。小型公开售票未必适合年度项目协议。页面宣传英国支持团队 7am–10pm，但服务日、时区、SLA 和假日需合同确认。源码许可、自托管、数据保留、离线签到核对及恢复未核实。

research_gaps: No governance, permissions, CRM, app, offline check-in or export was tested.
Annual amount, exact integrations and support SLA, contract data controls, recovery, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.
